spec.description: Fleet status, client traffic, role control and native engine metrics for one Prometheus data source.

spec.title: Router
spec.description: Router admission readiness and firing Narwhal alerts.

spec.title: Token throughput
spec.description: Engine prompt tokens and router-observed output tokens per second.

One row per engine, in engine ID order. State shows the most serious state, ranking Restarting (unreachable during a drain), Unreachable, Blocked, Validating, Ejected, Draining, Quarantined, Verifying, Probation, Backlogged (vLLM has waiting requests), Switching (still finishing requests from its previous role) and Serving. Resident and vLLM running bars scale to the busiest engine; KV cache scales to 100%. Prefix hits is the share of prompt tokens served from the engine's prefix cache. Tokens/s counts prompt tokens on prefill engines and output tokens on decode engines. Select Engine detail to filter.

spec.title: Request outcomes
spec.description: Offered requests per second and the rate of each terminal outcome, plotted from zero.

spec.title: Retries and early exits
spec.description: Retry attempts per second, and requests per second that ended before input sizing.

spec.title: Time to first token
spec.description: Router arrival to prefill completion on the selected router. Quantiles use process-local histogram rates; the SLO series comes from the running router configuration.

spec.title: Time per output token
spec.description: Mean decode interval per completed request on the selected router. Quantiles use process-local histogram rates; the SLO series comes from the running router configuration.

spec.title: Request waiting time
spec.description: The selected router's p95 queue wait and admission-seat duration separate waiting from retained request lifetime.

spec.title: Pool pressure
spec.description: Scheduler pressure as a fraction of each pool's latency target, including the decode idle-floor correction.

spec.title: Fleet events
spec.description: Narwhal alerts that fired in the displayed interval, one row per alert and engine: red while a page alert fires, amber while a warning fires. The Router block in the headline row counts the alerts firing now.

spec.title: Pool assignments
spec.description: Engines assigned to each pool and engines held out by the breaker.

spec.title: Requests
spec.description: Requests that ended in the displayed interval. Within SLO is the share of ended requests that met both the TTFT and TPOT SLOs. Dropped is the share that was refused, rejected, failed or expired. Ended requests are completed, failed, refused, rejected, expired and cancelled requests.

spec.title: Latency
spec.description: 95th-percentile TTFT and TPOT on the selected router over the displayed interval, as a share of the SLO each router configuration had and as a time. With several configurations in the interval, each column shows the largest.

spec.expr: max(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (instance, slo, le) (increase(narwhal_ttft_seconds_bucket{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router"}[$__range]))) / on(instance, slo) max by (instance, slo) (max_over_time(narwhal_slo_seconds{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router",metric="ttft"}[$__range])))

max(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (instance, slo, le) (increase(narwhal_tpot_seconds_bucket{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router"}[$__range]))) / on(instance, slo) max by (instance, slo) (max_over_time(narwhal_slo_seconds{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router",metric="tpot"}[$__range])))

spec.title: Router event loop
spec.description: Event-loop busy share and monitoring-deadline lag of the selected router.
